<function name="SetWheelFriction" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets friction of given wheel.  This function may be broken.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="wheel" type="number">The wheel to change the friction of</arg>
		<arg name="friction" type="number">The new friction to set</arg>
	</args>
</function>
